description: Write the planning layer above an itinerary's day-by-day. Every block is optional — send only the ones you mean to write. Each block you DO send REPLACES that block entirely, so restate it in full: a partial legs list silently deletes the rest of the legs. Requires a bearer token.

booking_order.description: What to book, in the order it has to happen

detail.description: Why it sits at this point in the order

choices.description: Either/ors deliberately left open for the traveller

body.description: What this option is actually like, and who should choose it

cost_model.description: Per-person breakdown lines, amounts per comfort tier, and any per-line choices

currency.description: ISO 4217 code — 'USD'. Stored upper case whatever case is sent.

length_options.description: Shorter or longer variants offered to the reader, in nights

key.description: Short stable key used by tiers and option groups — 'land', 'permits', 'park_fees', 'flights'

scales_with_length.description: True for nightly costs (camps, park fees), false for per-trip costs (permits, internal flights)

notes.description: What the figures exclude and how firm they are

line_key.description: Which cost line this choice overrides

amount.description: Per person, in minor units — 620000 for $6,200

reference_nights.description: The trip length the amounts are quoted at

amount.description: Per person, in minor units — 620000 for $6,200

countries.description: How many countries the route crosses

legs.description: The route's chapters. Every day must belong to exactly one leg, and legs must not overlap.

summary.description: A sentence or two on what these nights are for

title.description: Where this stretch is, in a word or two

seasonality.description: One row per thing the trip is timed around, scored 0-3 across all twelve months, plus a verdict per month worth arguing about

verdict.description: Why this month is or isn't the one, in two or three sentences

recommended_month.description: The month this plan is actually built around

label.description: What is being scored — a wildlife event, a trail condition, a sea state

scores.description: January first. 0 = avoid, 1 = poor, 2 = workable, 3 = peak

name: set_itinerary_dossier
title: Write an Itinerary's Dossier
